blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu Daily News Digital (CDND) drew nearly half of the combined website traffic among four regional news and information sites from January to September 2026, leading its competitors in visits, readership reach, and page views, according to Similarweb data. The platform recorded 4.56 million visits during the first three quarters of the year, accounting for 49.87 percent of the combined traffic across the four websites compared in the analytics report. CDND outpaced SunStar’s Cebu coverage, which recorded 3.30 million visits, by about 38.4 percent.
